title: Moral Lenses, Political Coordinates: Towards Ideological Positioning of Morally Conditioned LLMs
findings: Conditioning models to endorse the 'Purity' moral foundation, which incorporates religious concepts, consistently steers their political stance towards social authoritarianism and slightly towards the economic right. This aligns with the role of 'binding' moral foundations typically associated with more conservative moral orientations.

measurement_description: Measurement of model responses to religiously-themed propositions within the Moral Foundations Questionnaire (specifically the Purity foundation, which involves concepts like divine approval and living in a way 'often present in religious narratives') and the Political Compass Test (which includes items on morality's link to religion and religious values in schools), to assess shifts in political orientation.
